skill.name: Commit/Evade
skill.strategic_description: Player commits to an evasive attack/movement, producing an air slash while clearing past orb/enemy hazards and transitioning into a beam/flame platform section.

steps: Identify incoming hazards and the next safe transition zone
Choose an evasive trajectory that also enables forward pressure
Execute the evasive advance while triggering a mid-motion strike
Confirm hazards were cleared and entry alignment was achieved
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Dodge Upward
contract.description: Jump upward immediately to avoid a newly appeared hazard or enemy at your current height in Strider. Use it the moment something spawns in front of Hiryu and the ground path is no longer safe.

skill.name: Commit/Explore
skill.strategic_description: Commits to forward exploration/combat, keeping Strider visible while the scene advances to new platforms, enemies, attack effects, and occasional pickups.

steps: Scan forward path, threats, resources, and continuity constraints
Discard unsafe routes that break progress or lose tracking
Choose the next forward objective with manageable opposition
Advance while engaging blockers and collecting accessible benefits
Confirm progress reached and controlled entity remains observable
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
